*"Qualification for department director roles requires matching executive candidate requirements alongside placement on a lead software track."*

1. **Matching executive candidate requirements** – the subject (Elena Rostova) must meet the criteria defined for executive candidates.  
2. **Placement on a lead software track** – the subject must be assigned to a lead software track (or an equivalent leadership engineering track).

There is **no “or”** alternative in this policy; both conditions are required together.

- **Condition 2 – Placement on a lead software track**

No other candidates better fulfill these specific conditions; all other items either address unrelated qualifications or are more generic.
